name: EBRM NT core lexicon
note: Bilingual core lexicon. type: t/undefined=teachable, x=inflection, n=proper noun. jesus/christ corrected to proper nouns.

baptize.gloss: to dip, to wash in water

witness.gloss: one who tells what he saw

judgment.gloss: the deciding of right and wrong

priest.gloss: one who serves at the altar

star.gloss: a light in the night sky

leaf.gloss: the green part of a plant

leaves.gloss: the green parts of a plant

mark.gloss: the writer of the second gospel

antioch.gloss: where disciples were first called Christians

isaiah.gloss: the prophet of the coming One

zechariah.gloss: the father of John the Baptist

elizabeth.gloss: the mother of John the Baptist

nicodemus.gloss: the teacher who came by night

well.gloss: in a good way; a water hole
